  • Method Details

    • getExtra

      @NotNull @NotNull Map<net.kyori.adventure.key.Key,String> getExtra()
      Retrieves additional data associated with the shop in the form of key-value pairs.
      Returns:
      A non-null map containing extra shop data. The map keys and values represent custom data associated with the shop, where both keys and values are strings.
      Since:
      6.3.0.0

    • getExtra

      @Nullable @Nullable String getExtra(@NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.NamespacedKey key)
      Retrieves the extra value associated with the specified key.
      Parameters:
      key - the NamespacedKey used to locate the extra value; must not be null
      Returns:
      the associated extra value as a String, or null if no value is found
      Since:
      6.3.0.0

    • getExtra

      @Nullable @Nullable String getExtra(@NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.NamespacedKey key, @Nullable @Nullable String defaultValue)
      Retrieves the value associated with the specified NamespacedKey from the additional shop data. If the specified key does not exist in the data, the provided default value is returned.
      Parameters:
      key - The NamespacedKey representing the key used to retrieve the value. This must not be null.
      defaultValue - The default value to return if the specified key is not found. This can be null.
      Returns:
      The value associated with the specified key, or the default value if the key is not found. Can return null if the default value is null.
      Since:
      6.3.0.0

    • getExtra

      @Nullable default @Nullable Integer getExtra(@NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.NamespacedKey key, @Nullable @Nullable Integer defaultValue)
      Retrieves an extra value associated with the given key and attempts to parse it as an Integer. If no value is found or the value cannot be parsed, the provided defaultValue is returned.
      Parameters:
      key - the namespaced key used to lookup the extra value, must not be null
      defaultValue - the default value to return if no value is found or parsing fails, can be null
      Returns:
      the parsed integer value associated with the key, or defaultValue if no value exists or parsing fails
      Since:
      6.3.0.0

    • getExtra

      @Nullable default @Nullable Long getExtra(@NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.NamespacedKey key, @Nullable @Nullable Long defaultValue)
      Retrieves an extra value associated with the specified key, attempting to parse it as a Long. If the value is not present or cannot be parsed, the provided default value is returned.
      Parameters:
      key - the NamespacedKey used to look up the associated value; must not be null
      defaultValue - the default value to return if the value is not found or cannot be parsed; may be null
      Returns:
      the parsed Long value associated with the key, or the defaultValue if unavailable or unparseable
      Since:
      6.3.0.0

    • getExtra

      @Nullable default @Nullable Double getExtra(@NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.NamespacedKey key, @Nullable @Nullable Double defaultValue)
      Retrieves the extra value associated with the specified key as a Double. If the value is not present or cannot be parsed as a Double, the provided default value is returned.
      Parameters:
      key - the NamespacedKey used to look up the extra value; must not be null
      defaultValue - the default Double value to return if no value is present or parsing fails; may be null
      Returns:

      Since:
      6.3.0.0

      @Nullable default @Nullable Float getExtra(@NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.NamespacedKey key, @Nullable @Nullable Float defaultValue)
      Retrieves a floating-point number associated with the given key from extra data. If no value is found or the value cannot be parsed as a float, the specified default value is returned.
      Parameters:
      key - the key to look up in the extra data; must not be null
      defaultValue - the default value to return if the key is not found or cannot be parsed; can be null

      Since:

    • setExtra

      void setExtra(@NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin plugin, @Nullable @Nullable Map<String,String> data)
      Associates additional data with the shop using a plugin-specific namespace. The provided data map contains key-value pairs that will be stored.
      Parameters:
      plugin - The plugin instance used to generate the namespace for the extra data. This ensures the data is associated with the correct plugin context.
      data - A map containing key-value pairs of additional data to be stored. If null, no data will be set. Keys are prefixed with a namespaced key specific to the provided plugin.
      Since:
      6.3.0.0

      data - A non-null string representing the additional data to be stored.
      Since:

      default String serializeExtra()
